recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow completion of the Applied Jira resolution and no broader subscriptions polling change is indicated by the available evidence.
issue_request: FHIR-47283 was Applied and resolved Persuasive with Modification for R6. It requested replacing unclear wording that events are observed using Bundles and the history operation with wording that polling-based methods observe events using both search and history interactions.
initial_application: Commit 75068c1b9c7a78ed76359614adb95feb58a900f6 applied the main clarification by changing the paragraph from Bundle/history wording to search/history interactions, but left the sentence saying "a polling-based method" despite the approved resolution and implementation commit subject referring to methods.
additional_context: The page is in current build scope as source/subscriptions.html, listed in source/hierarchy.xml and linked from the active Subscription, SubscriptionStatus, and SubscriptionTopic resource pages. FHIR-I approved the subscription block vote containing FHIR-47283 on 2025-03-31, and PR HL7/fhir#3967 later merged the subscription-related source updates.
reconciliation: Changed source/subscriptions.html so the sentence now says "polling-based methods for observing events using both search and history interactions."
source_changes: source/subscriptions.html: changed "a polling-based method" to "polling-based methods" in the Subscriptions Framework polling paragraph.
